text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days before Valentine's Day—

text_block_list.name: Clerk A
text_block_list.text: The end of the line for "Hiam", the cutting-edge chocolate brand from Dubai, is right over here!

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk B
text_block_list.text:
"As seen on TV!
Our super popular seashell-shaped chocolates
are limited in quantity! Get yours soon!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
Another year has begun, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's is coming...! 
—I am definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Between tasks, my thoughts drifted to Verxina.
She had slipped away for just a few hours
to buy Valentine's gifts for her family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems she enthusiastically participates every year, gathering intel just to make her younger sisters happy, showing incredible dedication.
choice_data_list: (Maybe I should prepare something too.)
(Maybe I should prepare something, too.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's always working hard for others, so I wanted to show my appreciation...
After giving it a lot of thought, I decided to go with a classic, well-known brand.
choice_data_list: (I'm aiming for the very top of the chocolate world!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then came
Valentine's Day."
choice_data_list: Have you given the chocolates to your family yet?
Have you given the chocolates to your family yet?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Everyone was so happy!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos was especially thrilled...!
It was well worth waiting in line for two hours.
choice_data_list: I see. That's great.
I see, that's great to hear.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...And well, about that."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Happy Valentine's,
Trainer-san!
choice_data_list: Huh... To me?
Huh... For me?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Back then,
I caused you trouble with adjusting my training and all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Of course, this isn't just for this one time,
but a thank-you for everything up until now."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I do not believe this is enough to repay you.
However... thank you, as always.
choice_data_list: ...Well then, thank you as always from me too!
...Well then, thank you as always, from me too!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: —Wait... hold on. Could this brand be...
choice_data_list: It's a pretty famous place, right?
I take it it's a fairly famous place?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes! Actually... I absolutely love it. Its gentle, melt-in-your-mouth texture is utterly enchanting.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been able to eat any lately,
so I'm really happy!
choice_data_list: That's great!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
However... it's a classic brand,
so didn't that make it even harder to choose?
I was researching all sorts of things, after all...
choice_data_list: No, I actually thought there wouldn't be any overlap.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For her sisters' sake, Verxina always tried to choose fresh new brands each year.
If that's the case, she'll likely avoid the mainstream classics—
choice_data_list: When I thought about what was best for you, I didn't hesitate.
When I thought about what's best for you, I didn't hesitate.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Um,
about this chocolate...?"
choice_data_list: Of course, you can give some to your little sisters too.
Of course, you can give some to your little sisters too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Do you not mind it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: After taking the trouble to give it all to me, you're asking to share it instead?
choice_data_list: Because I know that brings you the ultimate joy.
Because I know that brings you the greatest joy of all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, delicious~♡♡
I absolutely love this brand!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Still, are you sure it's okay...?
...It's from your Trainer, right?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's alright, don't worry.
Go ahead and eat as much as you like.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because you... really understand me
so well, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(To think Trainer-san cared about me
that much...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if that was enough?
I chose a more mature brand than what I gave my little sisters, but...)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(...Is this really enough?
Can I truly say I've considered everything for their sake?
Should I head back to the event venue right now and get more――)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...No, even that's not enough.
In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Phew, finished melting the extra batch!
Next is carving the chocolate decorations...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No, it's not working...! 
Is there anything else I could use...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...In the back of the second shelf in the fridge.
There are edible rose flowers, so why don't you use them?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Um...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Opera O just forced it on me,
and it was a nuisance, that's all.
If you don't want it, throw it away.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
Thank you, very much!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the decorations are all set.
Now for the rest...—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (Considering the dorm curfew, I'm almost out of time... Will I make it in time...!?)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...No, I'll make it in time!
Just like when I used to make things for my little sisters back then--"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Pour your heart into it and make it complete!
This race... I am NOT going to lose!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That night, I was suddenly summoned by Verxina.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
—Please take this!"
choice_data_list: Wait, is this...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
It's a Valentine's chocolate cake.
Freshly made and still warm.
choice_data_list: Handmade?! Wait, earlier too...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Both of them are packed full
of... my precious feelings for you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
One is my gratitude.
The other is...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"A grea— designed with
every thought for your sake—"
choice_data_list: ...huh?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I-It's... deep... deep...
deep—deepest gratitude, from the bottom of my heart!
choice_data_list: Verxina... Thank YOU so much!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes.
I am most delighted that you enjoyed it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(I almost spoke to them the way
I talk to my little sisters...
――T-That was close... right?)
